'''Jean-Pierre Kahane''' (11 December 1926 – 21 June 2017) was a French [[mathematician]] with contributions to [[harmonic analysis]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/jean-pierre-kahane|title = Jean-Pierre Kahane - Scholars &#124; Institute for Advanced Study|date = 9 December 2019}}</ref> He's also credited for introducing [[Sub-Gaussian Random Variable|sub-gaussian random variables]].<ref>{{Citation |last=Giorgobiani |first=George |chapter=Notes on Sub-Gaussian Random Elements |date=2020 |title=Applications of Mathematics and Informatics in Natural Sciences and Engineering |volume=334 |pages=197–203 |editor-last=Jaiani |editor-first=George |chapter-url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-030-56356-1_11 |access-date=2026-01-31 |place=Cham |publisher=Springer International Publishing |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-030-56356-1_11 |isbn=978-3-030-56355-4 |last2=Kvaratskhelia |first2=Vakhtang |last3=Tarieladze |first3=Vaja |editor2-last=Natroshvili |editor2-first=David|chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref>

==Career==
Kahane attended the [[École normale supérieure]] and obtained the ''[[agrégation]]'' of mathematics in 1949. He then worked for the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] from 1949 to 1954, first as an intern and then as a research assistant. He defended his [[PhD]] in 1954; his advisor was [[Szolem Mandelbrojt]].

He was assistant [[professor]], then professor of mathematics in [[Montpellier]] from 1954 to 1961. Since then, he has been professor until his retirement in 1994,<ref>Kahane, Jean-Pierre.[http://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/WAspad/UnTexteDeJorf?numjo=RESM9400652A Ministerial decision of 6 April 1994]</ref> then [[professor emeritus]] at the [[Université de Paris-Sud]] in [[Orsay]].

He was a Plenary Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1962 in Stockholm<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1962.1/Main/icm1962.1.0114.0131.ocr.pdf "Transformées de Fourier des fonctions sommables" par J.-P. Kahane] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131228051228/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1962.1/Main/icm1962.1.0114.0131.ocr.pdf |date=2013-12-28 }} In ''Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians''. 1962, pp. 114–131</ref> and an Invited Speaker at the 1986 ICM meeting in Berkeley, California.<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1986.2/Main/icm1986.2.1682.1696.ocr.pdf "Enseignement Mathematique, Ordinateurs et Calculettes"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161003180742/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1986.2/Main/icm1986.2.1682.1696.ocr.pdf |date=2016-10-03 }} par J.-P. Kahane In ''International Congress of Mathematicians'', 1986, pp. 1682–1696</ref> He was elected corresponding member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 1982 and full member in 1998.<ref>[http://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/WAspad/UnTexteDeJorf?numjo=MENP9803330D Decree of 5 January 1999]</ref> He was president of the [[Société mathématique de France]], the French Mathematical Society from 1971 to 1973. In 2000 Kahane received an [[Honorary degree|honorary doctorate]] from the Faculty of Science and Technology at [[Uppsala University]], [[Sweden]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/traditions/prizes/honorary-doctorates/|title = Honorary doctorates - Uppsala University, Sweden| date=9 June 2023 }}</ref>
In 2002 he was elevated to the rank of commander in the order of the [[Légion d'Honneur]].<ref>[http://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/WAspad/UnTexteDeJorf?numjo=PREX0200002D Decree of 29 March 2002]</ref> In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-01-27.</ref>

==Activism==
Kahane was also known for his lifelong activism as part of the [[French Communist Party]].<ref>Schwartz, Laurent. A mathematician grappling with his century. Birkhäuser, 2012. [https://books.google.com/books?id=Mw8HCAAAQBAJ&dq=jean+pierre+kahane+communist&pg=PA393]</ref>

==Selected publications==
*''Lectures on mean periodic functions'' (Bombay, Tata Institute, 1959).
*''Séries de Fourier absolument convergentes'', Ergebnisse der Mathematik und ihrer Grenzgebiete, vol. 50, Springer Verlag  1970
*with [[Raphaël Salem]]: ''Ensembles parfaits et séries trigonométriques'', Hermann, 1963,<ref>{{cite journal|author=Rudin, Walter|title=Review: ''Ensembles parfaits et séries trigonométriques'' by Jean-Pierre Kahane and Raphaël Salem|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1964|volume=70|issue=4|pages=487–490|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1964-70-04/S0002-9904-1964-11161-7/S0002-9904-1964-11161-7.pdf|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1964-11161-7|doi-access=free}}</ref> 1994
*''Some random series of functions'', Lexington, Massachusetts, D. C. Heath 1968, 2nd edition Cambridge University Press 1985
*''Séries de Fourier aléatoires'', Presse de l’ Université de Montreal 1967
*editor with A. G. Howson: ''The Popularization of Mathematics'', Cambridge University Press 1990
*''Des series de Taylor au movement brownien, avec un apercu sur le retour'', in Jean-Paul Pier, ''Development of mathematics 1900–1950'', Birkhäuser 1994
